_comment: Item definitions. Numbers follow the 5e SRD 5.1 equipment tables (CC-BY-4.0). See docs/ITEMS.md.

gold.name: Gold
gold.description: Gold pieces. Picked-up gold goes straight into the party's purse.

longsword.name: Longsword
longsword.description: A straight, double-edged blade with a cross guard. Versatile: 1d10 when held in both hands.

shortsword.name: Shortsword
shortsword.description: Light enough to fight with one in each hand.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.description: A plain steel dagger. Can be thrown.

mace.name: Mace
mace.description: A flanged iron head on a stout haft.

quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
quarterstaff.description: A shod staff of seasoned ash. Versatile: 1d8 when held in both hands.

rapier.name: Rapier
rapier.description: A slender thrusting sword with a swept hilt.

greataxe.name: Greataxe
greataxe.description: A broad-bladed axe on a long haft. Needs both hands.

warhammer.name: Warhammer
warhammer.description: A smith's pride: a balanced hammer with a spiked back.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description: A recurved hunting bow. Needs both hands, and arrows.

arrows.name: Arrows
arrows.description: Goose-fletched arrows with iron bodkin points.

leather.name: Leather Armour
leather.description: Boiled and oiled leather. AC 11 + Dex modifier.

studded_leather.name: Studded Leather
studded_leather.description: Tough leather reinforced with close-set rivets. AC 12 + Dex modifier.

chain_shirt.name: Chain Shirt
chain_shirt.description: Interlocking rings worn between layers of clothing. AC 13 + Dex modifier (max 2).

chain_mail.name: Chain Mail
chain_mail.description: A full coat of mail over quilted padding. AC 16. Heavy: Strength 13 to move freely.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: A round wooden shield with an iron boss. +2 AC.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: A plain iron cap with a nasal guard. Mostly it keeps the rain off.

cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_of_protection.description: A deep green cloak that turns aside blows. +1 AC while worn.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: A silver band set with a small blue stone. +1 AC while worn.

silver_amulet.name: Silver Amulet
silver_amulet.description: A sun disc on a fine chain. Pretty, and worth something to the right buyer.

potion_of_healing.name: Potion of Healing
potion_of_healing.description: A red liquid that glimmers when shaken. Drinking it restores 2d4 + 2 hit points.

potion_of_greater_healing.name: Potion of Greater Healing
potion_of_greater_healing.description: A deeper red, almost violet. Restores 4d4 + 4 hit points.

rations.name: Rations
rations.description: A day's dry food: hard bread, cheese and salted meat.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: Crisp and a little sour. Restores 1 hit point.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: Pitch-soaked rags on a stick. Burns for about an hour.

lantern.name: Hooded Lantern
lantern.description: A brass lantern with a hinged hood to dim it.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.description: A carved sunburst of the dawn, worn smooth by prayer.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves_tools.description: Picks, a small mirror and narrow-bladed scissors in a leather roll. Needed to pick locks.

spellbook.name: Spellbook
spellbook.description: A wizard's book of spells, its margins thick with notes.

garnet.name: Garnet
garnet.description: A deep red gemstone the size of a fingernail.

reeve_key.name: Reeve's Key
reeve_key.description: A heavy iron key on a leather thong, stamped with the reeve's mark.
